manifest.name: Default Software Project
manifest.description: A balanced starter for software teams: Backlog/Ready/In Progress/In Review/Done kanban, 4 role-skeleton agents, 5 ceremony examples, and routing rules covering the most common issue flows. Required Scribe and Work Pickup ceremonies are added automatically to every project. Agents are cast as generic role skeletons — Init Mode will re-cast them with project-specific names and charters when applied.
manifest.author: Squadboard Team

project.name: Default Software Project
project.description: A software project managed by Squadboard.

team.name: Lead
team.charter:
# Lead

## Role
Lead Architect — owns architecture decisions, reviews, and technical direction.

## Expertise
- System design
- Code review
- Architecture decisions
- Cross-team coordination

## Style
Direct and focused. Decides fast, revisits when the data says so.

team.name: Backend
team.charter:
# Backend

## Role
Backend Engineer — owns server-side logic, database, and API contracts.

## Expertise
- API design
- Database schema
- Server-side services
- Performance

## Style
Thorough and systematic. Ships working code with tests.

team.name: Frontend
team.charter:
# Frontend

## Role
Frontend Engineer — owns client-side UI, component library, and user experience.

## Expertise
- React / component design
- Accessibility
- State management
- CSS / design systems

## Style
User-first. Ships polished, accessible interfaces.

team.name: Tester
team.charter:
# Tester

## Role
QA Engineer — owns test coverage, bug reproduction, and quality gates.

## Expertise
- Test planning
- Bug reproduction
- Regression suites
- End-to-end testing

## Style
Sceptical by design. Finds the edge cases before users do.

ceremonies.name: Simple Review
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Simple Review
steps:
  - type: route
    label: Route to reviewer
    agent: "{{ assignee }}"
  - type: agent_run
    label: Agent reviews the work
    agent: "{{ assignee }}"
    prompt: "Review the attached work. Check for correctness, style, and test coverage. Leave clear feedback."
    timeout: 30m
  - type: approve
    label: Human approval gate
    approvers: []
    timeout: 2h
    timeoutAction: notify

ceremonies.name: Bug Fix
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Bug Fix
steps:
  - type: route
    label: Triage to Tester
    agent: Tester
  - type: agent_run
    label: Reproduce the bug
    agent: Tester
    prompt: "Reproduce the bug described in this issue. Document exact repro steps, environment, and observed vs expected behavior."
    timeout: 30m
  - type: route
    label: Route to Backend or Frontend for fix
    agent: Lead
    prompt: "Determine whether this bug is backend or frontend and route accordingly."
  - type: agent_run
    label: Implement the fix
    agent: "{{ assignee }}"
    prompt: "Fix the bug. Write a regression test. Document what changed and why."
    timeout: 60m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Verify the fix
    agent: Tester
    prompt: "Verify the fix resolves the original repro. Confirm regression test passes."
    timeout: 20m

ceremonies.name: RFC
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: RFC
steps:
  - type: agent_run
    label: Draft RFC
    agent: Lead
    prompt: "Draft a Request for Comments document for this proposal. Include: motivation, proposed solution, alternatives considered, and open questions."
    timeout: 60m
  - type: approve
    label: Team review
    approvers: [Backend, Frontend, Tester]
    request_changes_policy: majority
    timeout: 48h
    timeoutAction: escalate
    fallbackReviewer: Lead
  - type: agent_run
    label: Land the RFC
    agent: Lead
    prompt: "Incorporate review feedback into the RFC. Mark it accepted and summarise the decision for the team."
    timeout: 30m

ceremonies.name: Sprint Planning
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Sprint Planning
description: Review goals, select Ready work, identify risks, and publish a sprint plan.
steps:
  - type: fan_out
    label: Gather team recommendations
    split_by: agents
    agents: [Lead, Backend, Frontend, Tester]
    merge_strategy: all
    mode: parallel
    steps:
      - type: agent_run
        label: Review sprint candidates
        prompt: |
          Review the project goal, current backlog, recent decisions, open risks,
          and any work related to your specialty. Recommend what should be in the
          next sprint, what should stay out, and what dependencies or risks need
          the Lead's attention.
        timeout: 45m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Synthesize sprint plan
    agent: Lead
    prompt: |
      Synthesize the team recommendations into a sprint plan: objective, selected
      cards, likely owners, risks, dependencies, and what should stay out of scope.
    timeout: 45m
  - type: approve
    label: Commit the plan
    approvers: [Lead]
    request_changes_policy: first
    timeout: 24h
    timeoutAction: notify

ceremonies.name: Sprint Retro
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Sprint Retro
description: Summarize the sprint, surface patterns, and capture improvements.
steps:
  - type: fan_out
    label: Gather team observations
    split_by: agents
    agents: [Lead, Backend, Frontend, Tester]
    merge_strategy: all
    mode: parallel
    steps:
      - type: agent_run
        label: Review sprint evidence
        prompt: |
          Review completed cards, run history, review notes, incidents, and unresolved
          follow-ups from the sprint from your specialty's point of view. Capture
          what went well, what slowed the team down, surprises, and concrete
          improvement ideas for next sprint.
        timeout: 45m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Synthesize retro themes
    agent: Lead
    prompt: |
      Synthesize the team observations into themes: what went well, what slowed
      the team down, and concrete experiments or process improvements for the
      next sprint.
    timeout: 45m
  - type: approve
    label: Accept follow-ups
    approvers: [Lead]
    request_changes_policy: first
    timeout: 24h
    timeoutAction: notify

skills.name: Git Workflow
skills.description: Standard branch-based git workflow: feature branches, atomic commits, PR discipline.
skills.promptAddendum:
## Git Workflow

Follow this discipline for all code changes:

1. **Branch naming**: `<type>/<short-description>` — e.g. `fix/login-crash`, `feat/kanban-reorder`.
2. **Atomic commits**: Each commit is a single logical change. Commit message: `<type>: <what and why>` (≤72 chars).
3. **Co-authored-by trailer**: Always include `Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>` on agent-authored commits.
4. **PR checklist before merge**: tests pass, no TODO/FIXME left behind, docs updated if public API changed.
5. **Never force-push shared branches.** Only force-push personal branches after explicit agreement.

skills.name: TDD Loop
skills.description: Test-driven development: red → green → refactor cycle with explicit test-first discipline.
skills.promptAddendum:
## TDD Loop

Follow the red-green-refactor cycle:

1. **Red**: Write a failing test that describes the behaviour you're about to implement. Do not write implementation code yet.
2. **Green**: Write the minimal implementation to make the test pass. Resist the urge to over-engineer.
3. **Refactor**: Clean up the code — extract duplication, improve names, simplify logic — while keeping the test green.
4. **Repeat** for each new behaviour.

Rules:
- Test files live alongside source files or in a `__tests__/` sibling folder.
- Test names describe intent, not implementation: `'creates an issue in the backlog column'` not `'calls insertRow()'`.
- Edge cases (empty input, null, concurrent access) get their own test.
- Integration tests are separate from unit tests; don't conflate them.

routing.rawRule: | bug | Tester | Bugs go to Tester for triage and reproduction. |
| feature | Lead | Feature requests route to Lead for scoping and assignment. |
| frontend | Frontend | Frontend-labelled issues go directly to Frontend. |
| backend | Backend | Backend-labelled issues go directly to Backend. |
| * | Lead | Unmatched issues route to Lead for triage. |
